page: Amazon Web Services m6id.12xlarge is a general-purpose, storage-equipped virtual server powered by the AWS Nitro System. It operates on an Intel Xeon 8375C processor with x86_64 architecture, providing 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at 3.5 GHz. The CPU features 54 MB of L3 cache alongside hardware support for cryptographic acceleration and vector instructions, including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. System memory comprises 192 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3000 MHz, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core.

A key architectural differentiator of the m6id.12xlarge is its bundled local storage, featuring 2850 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD instance storage. This local volume provides low-latency disk access compared to network-attached block devices. Network connectivity is supported with a baseline throughput of 19 Gbps, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included. The server lacks hardware GPU acceleration.

Benchmark evaluations position the m6id.12xlarge solidly within middle-tier to upper-tier throughput brackets. Multi-core performance is robust, marked by a Geekbench multi-core score of 15,999.0 and a PassMark CPU encryption score of 43,553.35, placing both in the top 25% of measured instances. In-memory data structures perform well, demonstrated by 45.51 million Redis SET operations per second and 41.18 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. However, large model processing highlights resource limits; while small 135M model text generation is strong at 297.19 tokens/sec, large 70B parameter inference slows to 2.72 tokens/sec, falling into the bottom quartile due to CPU-bound execution.

The m6id.12xlarge represents a cost-efficient deployment for operations requiring balanced compute density coupled with high-speed temporary storage. The integrated 2850 GB NVMe capacity reduces reliance on provisioned external block storage fees for write-intensive scratch spaces, caching layers, and intermediate ETL staging. It is suited for relational database replicas, distributed caching nodes, CI/CD build environments, and containerized enterprise applications.
description: Amazon Web Services m6id.12xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro System, featuring an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. It provides 48 vCPUs, 24 physical cores, and 192 GB of DDR4 memory, delivering a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. Distinct from baseline general-purpose instances, it includes 2850 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage alongside a 19 Gbps baseline network capability. Benchmark data demonstrates strong multi-threaded execution, with top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core scoring (15,999.0) and hardware cryptographic operations, coupled with 45.51 million Redis SET operations per second. CPU-based processing on large 70B language models remains constrained due to the lack of dedicated GPU hardware. Combining high memory bandwidth with high-capacity local disk, the m6id.12xlarge fits database hosting, distributed caching, software compilation clusters, and data processing pipelines.
